newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Ekachart rates EGCOMP buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Ekachart rates EGCOMP buy.

text.p: Ekachart Finance and Securities on Wednesday said it rated the Electricity Generating Plc a buy for the long term based on its revenue earning potential.

Ekachart analyst Thaneit Khantigaroon that the firm, a subsidiary of state-owned Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT), had potential for strong future business growth as power was in demand and the utility planned to increase its electricity production.
"Electricity Generating is good for long term investment at present," Thaneit said. The company's shares were trading up one baht at 68 baht at 0759 GMT.
